meta.name: get-unpublished-changes
meta.description: Compare HEAD with the latest published npm versions and list all unpublished changes by release layer. Triggers: unpublished changes, changelog, what changed, whats new.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 列出尚未发布的 npm 改动,按发布层级分组。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把本地改动与已发布版本对比,发布前心中有数。
copy.tagline_en: See what changed since the last published npm release.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to review unpublished changes before releasing.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会拿当前代码与最新 npm 发布版本做对比，仔细查看实际改动，按发布层分门别类列出新功能、修复、重构，并给出每层及总体的版本升级建议。
howto.when: 当你说出‘unpublished changes’、‘changelog’、‘what changed’等关键词时触发。

say.text: 看看仓库里有哪些改动还没发布到 npm？
say.note: 会触发对比并列出未发布变更。

say.text: 对比最新 npm 包版本，按发布层列出未发布的 feat 和 fix。
say.note: 生成按层分类的变更说明。

say.text: 这次未发布的改动有哪些破坏性变更？版本号怎么升？
say.note: 给出每层和总体的版本升级建议。

howto.what_en: Claude compares HEAD with the latest published npm versions, reads actual diffs, classifies real changes by release layer (omo pure components, omo opencode, omo codex), lists added/fixed/refactored changes, and recommends per-layer plus one overall version bump.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user says 'unpublished changes', 'changelog', 'what changed', or 'whats new'.

say_en.text: See what changes in the repo haven't been published to npm yet?
say_en.note: Triggers a HEAD-to-latest comparison and lists unpublished changes.

say_en.text: Compare to the latest npm release and list unpublished features/fixes by layer.
Any breaking changes in unpublished work? What version bump do you recommend?
say_en.note: Gives per-layer and overall version recommendations.
